newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 13.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
- A Saudi Arabian jumbo jet collided with a Kazakh Airlines plane over New Delhi, killing all 351 passengers.
- Canada is prepared to lead an international force into eastern Zaire to bring food and protection to refugees.
- Muslims and Serbs fought near the Bosnian town of Gajevi in the worst skirmish since the Dayton peace accord.
- New York police stumbled upon the headquarters of a heavily armed leftist cult.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton has softened his opposition to a constitutional amendment to balance the federal budget.
- The U.S. army is checking hundreds of sexual harassment complaints by female trainees in all of its training bases.
- Civil rights leaders called for a national boycott of Texaco Inc to protest against alleged racial problems inside the company.
